rationale: Record test-only ctest scheduling for Pulp's real-browser capture validation. pulp-browser-capture-node-integration drops RUN_SERIAL for PROCESSORS 4, a shared `browser` RESOURCE_LOCK and a COST so it starts first; run_integration.mjs caps its file concurrency at the same reservation (PULP_BROWSER_CAPTURE_RESERVED_CORES), so a 3-vCPU VM still runs one file at a time alone and larger VMs run two. The process-lifecycle suite, the [browser]-tagged import-design-tool case and the agent-panel invariants take the same lock. Every test case, per-case and outer timeout, production browser capture, design ingest, captured output, rendering, packaging, the accepted expansion boundary, and Vellum source authority are unchanged.
